a.en: Listed location: Jl. Godean No.130, Area Sawah, Banyuraden, Kec. Gamping, Kabupaten Sleman, DI Yogyakarta 55293. Check directions before travelling.

a.en: The directory lists Monday–Saturday noon–9 PM WIB; another source lists different hours. Confirm the current schedule.
